about.text: Chal is the Turkmen fermented camel milk, a sparkling white, sour drink. It is the regional counterpart of Kazakh shubat, and is difficult to export because it is perishable.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Fermented in a skin bag or ceramic jar, started with soured milk and topped up with fresh milk over three to four days (the Uzbek qumron method)
Camel milk takes about 8 hours to sour at 30 °C, against about 3 hours for cow's milk
